summary: Six distinct refinance opportunities qualify from the 20 base extracts, all Charlotte multifamily with active_confirmed debt, executed and unextended maturities inside 2026-09-01..2027-08-31, record-owner verification on 2026-08-10, and a current Director of Finance verified 2026-08-10. Ranked by maturity ascending then original principal descending: R1514 (Alder Grove 1, 2027-01-15, $14,400,000; duplicate R6774 merged), R4598 (Alder Park 3, 2027-03-15, $16,560,000), R7567 (Alder Square 4, 2027-04-15, $17,640,000), R8446 (Alder Grove 5, 2027-05-15, $18,720,000), R2663 (Alder Grove 6, 2027-06-15, $19,800,000), R3927 (Alder Crossing 7, 2027-07-15, $20,880,000). Fourteen records were excluded: post-cutoff publication (R6607), out-of-scope market/asset (R9859, R3320), non-owner or stale owner evidence (R5582, R4360), registered-agent-only or former contact (R2193, R1100), unconfirmed/inferred maturity or unresolved extension (R6400, R2682), released or unknown loan status (R3086, R2324), executed extension pushing maturity out of window (R6902), and maturity outside the window (R8411). Two evidence overrides mattered before the cutoff: U-R6902-1 (executed amendment, disqualifying) and U-R7567-3 (unsigned draft, ignored); U-R4598-2 is dated after the cutoff and was not applied. All amounts reported are original principal; outstanding balances are unknown (null) in every source, and R8446's email is unpublished (null). No comp-grid XLSX or prospect CSV was produced in this direct API control mode; the shortlist facts above contain the full field set and citations needed to build one.
limitations: outstanding_balance_usd is null in every extract; original principal (loan_amount_basis original_principal) must not be read as current balance, so refinance sizing cannot be assessed.

R4598 has a recorded release (U-R4598-2) published and effective 2026-09-10; it is after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and thus non-controlling here, but the loan is very likely no longer active in reality and should be re-verified before outreach.
R7567's maturity rests on the base executed note only; the 2028-01-01 date in U-R7567-3 could become controlling if that draft is later executed.
R6607 may well be a qualifying Charlotte multifamily opportunity but its sole source was published 2026-09-03, after the cutoff, so it is unverifiable within scope.
R1514/R6774 are duplicate sources for entity ALDER-REF-61562; no independent confirmation exists that they are separate assets or loans, and no sponsor/parent-SPV mapping is supplied for any record.

Contact seniority, employment status and owner ownership all derive from a single verification date (2026-08-10, evidence_kind note_owner_confirmation_and_team_page); no second-source confirmation of role or email deliverability is available.
No lender, rate, DSCR, occupancy, prepayment or NOI data is present in the packet, so refinance urgency and economics are unquantified.
Email for R8446 is explicitly not published and reported as null; no enrichment was performed.
Fewer than ten qualifying records exist; the shortlist is limited by evidence, not truncated.
